mapper.insert: insert into review (order_id, user_id, score, content, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from review where order_id = #{orderId}

select r.id, r.order_id, r.score, r.content, r.create_time, r.sentiment, r.tags, ifnull(nullif(u.name, ''), concat(substr(u.phone,1,3),'****',substr(u.phone,8))) as user_name, group_concat(distinct od.name order by od.name separator '、') as dishes from review r left join user u on u.id = r.user_id left join order_detail od on od.order_id = r.order_id
and r.score = #{score} and r.create_time >= #{beginTime} and r.create_time <= #{endTime} and r.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
group by r.id order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc

select r.id as reviewId, r.order_id as orderId, r.score, r.sentiment, r.tags, r.content, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, group_concat(distinct od.dish_id order by od.dish_id) as dishIds, group_concat(distinct od.name order by od.name) as dishNames from review r left join order_detail od on od.order_id = r.order_id where r.id > #{lastId} and r.create_time >= #{beginTime} group by r.id order by r.id limit #{limit}
